content: अहुत {%a.%} .²1 Not sacrificed or offered (as an oblation); अवश्यं याति तिर्यक्त्वं जग्ध्वा चैवाहुतं हविः. .²2 Wrongly sacrificed; न चाहुतमभूत्तत्र <ls>Rām. 1. 14. 40</ls>. .²3 One who has not yet received any oblation. .{@-तः@} Religious meditation, prayer, and the study of the Vedas (considered as one of the five great Yajñas and necessary duties); अहुतं च हुतं चैव तथा प्रहुतमेव च . ब्राह्मं हुतं प्राशितं च पञ्च यज्ञान् प्रचक्षते .. <ls>Ms. 3. 73. 74</ls>.
